{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient_id
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check site count
print(data_dedup['site'].unique())

# Compute response rate by site
response_rate_by_site = data_dedup.groupby('site')['responded'].mean().round(4)

# Output
response_rate_by_site"}
